<article title="Product care">
Wash technical shells and down jackets on a gentle cycle with a technical-fabric wash, never regular detergent, and tumble dry on low. Down jackets need two or three clean tennis balls in the dryer to restore loft.

Waterproof coatings wear down with use. If water stops beading on a shell, wash it and apply a spray-on re-proofing treatment; this restores the coating without affecting the warranty.

Store sleeping bags and down items uncompressed in a dry place. Long-term compression permanently reduces insulation.

</article>

Customer first name: Isabella
<request>
how to wash a down jacket
what is the right way to wash my fernwood down jacket without ruining the insulation?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Isabella,

Thanks for reaching out! To care for your down jacket and protect the insulation, wash it on a gentle cycle using a technical-fabric wash, never regular detergent. Tumble dry on low, and add two or three clean tennis balls to the dryer to help restore loft.

If you have further questions, a specialist will be happy to follow up.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
